item.title: Kyuukyoku Mahou Shoujo Zettai☆Aneki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Axis
  • 発売日: 2011-04-08
  • スコア: 6.7700000000000005/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 究極魔法少女 絶対☆姉貴
  • 英語名: Kyuukyoku Mahou Shoujo Zettai☆Aneki

あらすじ

Akira’s older sister Hikari is amazing, placing tops in the national mock exams, almost setting world records in athletics and she’s even a ‘mahou shoujo’ that takes care of bad guys. As the school’s representative, she was given the opportunity to enact any proposition that she wants. She announces to everyone that she will be attacking any club that she wishes and if they lose to her, then they will be disbanded. With a smile, she wished everyone good luck. To save their ‘volunteer club’, they decide to fight back with all they’ve got.

item.title: Custard Cream Taiyaki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Axis
  • 発売日: 2010-04-30
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: カスタードクリームたい焼き
  • 英語名: Custard Cream Taiyaki

あらすじ

One day while returning home, Raikou gets in trouble and meets his childhood friend Aira who he hadn’t seen since he was small. He wondered why she came back and she said that she has an arranged marriage with him, however she just wants to keep her promise with him. The next day, Aira transfers into his school and announces to everyone that she’ll be marrying him, which surprises everyone since no one knows of their relationship. Aira moves in his house, as well as Kanae and Ayaka, since they find Aira too suspicious.
